links.comparator_used: Minimum specific prompts (least clinician input) for the same two clinical scenarios
links.outcome: Clinical accuracy, completeness and descriptive detail of AI-generated dental dictations
links.effect: All 5 programs produced clinically accurate dictations with the structured prompt. No substantial differences in procedural accuracy were identified, and discrepancies were mainly stylistic or in level of descriptive detail. Minimum prompts gave shorter, less descriptive dictations that were still clinically acceptable in all programs. No numeric effect sizes were reported.
links.tradeoff: Minimum prompts gave shorter, less descriptive output, though still acceptable and possibly useful in busy settings. Structured prompts need more clinician input.
links.quote: With minimum specific prompts, the dictations were shorter and less descriptive but still captured the essential procedural steps for both clinical scenarios and were considered clinically acceptable in all included AI software programs.
